items.title: For two immersions over a smooth morphism the conormal sequence is short exact
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter morphisms.tex (Morphisms of Schemes)

items.difficulty_reason: The lemma says that for a commutative triangle of immersions with the ambient morphism smooth, the conormal sequence relating the two conormal sheaves and the pullback of the differentials of the smooth morphism is short exact (statement lines 7454-7472). The counted proof is short and complete: it recalls the conormal sequence for the triangle, which is exact at the middle and right terms, and identifies the missing exactness at the left term with the algebraic statement for a surjection composed with a smooth ring map (proof lines 7474-7485). It is H2: the reduction is carried out in the counted span and the cited input is the corresponding algebraic exactness statement.
